paragraphs: Ravin bar Chinena before Rav Chisda (I did not find it). He came with his brother Rav Dimi before Rava (see there); Chullin 75b has bar Chanina. He spoke to Rav Ashi, Pesachim 109b. This requires examination: he was before Rav Chisda, Rava, and Rav Ashi. Perhaps he lived long, or spoke to the early Rav Ashi. He said in Ulla’s name in Rabbi Chanina’s name, Menachot 31b. Rabbi Zeira asked about it [קבעיה א׳; wording compressed]; Ravin b.Ch. said, “Thus said Ulla.” In Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name, Chullin 122, end of a.
